visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tab bar switching between rich content panels (product options, life stages)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Underlined text tab bar above one visible panel; icon-stepper turns the tabs into connected round icon steps with a highlighted panel

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab; cell 1: tab label (optionally an :icon: or image before the text); cell 2: panel content (headings, text, lists) or a single link to a fragment (e.g. /fragments/tabs/einmalanlage) when the panel holds other blocks; further cells become side-by-side panel columns

reuseGuidance: Use for tabbed panels. Put panels that contain blocks (boxes, cards, notes) in a fragment and author the fragment link in the panel cell; the fragment loads when the tab is first shown (the first tab on page load). Use the icon-stepper option for icon step/timeline navigation instead of a new block.
